purpose: Decouple window length from the FFT-grid discretisation of the band-pass response by fixing n_fft.
zero_padding_statement: zero-padding does not increase true spectral resolution and is used only to isolate FFT-grid discretization from temporal-window length

canonical_baseline.source: P1 / P3 / P2 reproduction; P2b anchor re-checked in-harness

frozen.reference: non-causal resample_poly(5,2) + zero-phase butter 0.5-1.25 Hz + Hilbert

comparison.decision_rule: supported = best fixed-grid subject MAE beats the canonical 8 s baseline with >= 10 of 13 subjects improved; selection valid = supported AND Spearman(n_fft=2000, n_fft=4000) >= 0.7; the optimum is not declared final if it sits on the 0.75 s search boundary
